scope: Local source snapshot, isolated package outputs and intentionally damaged fixtures. No publication, user browser or network API.

results.name: Build validates staged resources and automatically emits both audited ZIPs and SHA256 checksums
Identical source bytes produce identical runtime/source ZIPs despite changed source modification times
New source modules join the runtime inventory and missing transitive imports fail validation
Syntax errors in first-party runtime code fail the build checks
Remote module imports fail validation without executing or fetching them
Missing bundled PDF codec is detected before an installable package is produced
Private-file rejection preserves existing output packages and leaves no staging directory
Archive auditing rejects an omitted binary even when no static import names it
Archive auditing rejects modified runtime bytes
Archive auditing rejects development files injected into the runtime
Divergent hosted and installed English privacy policies fail validation
